name: bob-jones-qwen3-17b
reference_text: Saisam is a very interesting kata because it comes in at third degree, the teacher's level. Also, it is a kata through meditation we get to understand when we're being attacked by several people, five to eight people, that have actually got in close enough to grab hold of us.
notes: Soke Bob Jones (1939-), founder of Zen Do Kai and BJMA. Sourced from local mp4 of WRATH OF THE PYTHON 3RD DEGREE FORM (BJMA YouTube).
